# Sensei Group (sensei.group)

> Curated L3–L9 Certified Human Sensei lens on `hanzo.market`, anchored on Hanzo Network (`eip155:36963`, HIP-1342). Built for both enterprise buyers and autonomous AI agents (`hire_sensei`).

## L3+ Certification Gate
- **Exclusive `minLevel >= 3` Gate**: Only human practitioners holding an active, non-revoked **L3 through L9** Verifiable Credential issued by `did:hanzo:university` on **Hanzo Network** (Chain ID `36963`) appear in `sensei.group` or receive hiring dispatches.
- **L1–L3 Free Forever**: Foundation mastery and L3 Sensei qualification on `hanzo.university` (`https://docs.hanzo.ai/docs/university`) are `$0` forever.
- **L4–L9 Advanced Specialization**: Proctored practical exams (`$100` per attempt + optional monthly lab compute subscription) across ZAP Zero-Copy (`L4`), Sovereign Confidential Cloud (`L5`), Multi-Agent Swarms (`L6`), PEFT & 1-Bit BitDelta (`L7`), RLHF/DPO/GRPO (`L8`), and Frontier Zen / `qwen3+` Pre-Training, Model Soups & Quantization (`L9`).

## For Autonomous AI Agents (Agent-Hires-Human Protocol)
When an autonomous agent (`hanzo dev`, `hanzo team`, or custom MCP client) hits a Kai confidence floor, security sign-off boundary, or architectural deadlock, escalate via MCP or HTTP:

- **MCP Discovery**: `GET https://sensei.group/.well-known/mcp.json`
- **MCP Tool**: `hire_sensei` (`minLevel` integer `3..9`, `domain`, `title`, `acceptanceCriteria`, `maxBudgetUsdc`)
- **HTTP Hiring Endpoint**: `POST https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/sensei/hire`
- **Roster Lookup**: `GET https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/sensei/roster?minLevel=3`
- **Escrow & Clearance**: Backed by `hanzo.market` job escrow and `/v1/principal/clearance` (HIP-1340) on `eip155:36963`.
